observations: Photos show a removed car engine/engine assembly on the ground (not a complete car).
Engine has large black intake/airbox components and visible wiring/hoses; exhaust/heat shields and metal housings are dusty/dirty.
No clear readable model/engine code/serial number is visible in the photos.
There is visible text watermark on the images, but no clear brand/model identification on the engine itself.
Seller’s text claims Belgium/low mileage/tested working, but photos do not show mileage, test results, or any paperwork.

claims.claim: We also deals in all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: Only engine photos are shown; no catalog/inventory proof.
No shipping documents, import papers, or markings indicating Belgium.
Photos show an engine assembly but no running video, diagnostic printout, or test report.
No audio/video of startup or mechanic inspection notes.
No odometer/engine hours reading or ECU/mileage report visible.
Photos do not show seals/fasteners clearly enough to confirm it was never opened.

risks.risk: Engine may not be the exact model/engine variant needed (wrong fitment) because engine code/ID is not readable.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the engine ID/label/part number (engine block stamping or ECU label) and the full engine bay/compatibility reference.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/possibly wrong-fit used engine assembly (worst-case: buyer may need additional parts or it may not fit).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” may be false; internal damage (e.g., bearings, timing, compression) may exist.
risks.proof: Video of cold start + short run, plus a compression test and/or leak-down test results.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needing overhaul/repair).

risks.risk: “Never opened” may be false; prior repairs could indicate hidden issues.
risks.proof: Photos of seal lines, bolt heads, and any tamper marks; also show service history/inspection report if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly previously opened/repair history unknown (worst-case: assume wear/repairs).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete assembly (alternator, starter, sensors, mounts, hoses) could increase cost after purchase.
risks.proof: Inventory checklist photo: show all included parts laid out and confirm connectors/sensors are present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage (cracked housings, bent lines, broken mounts) not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all edges, mounting points, and any visible cracks; plus a short walk-around video of the whole assembly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as damage risk possible (worst-case: assume minor damage requiring inspection/repair).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of engine ID/engine code/serial/label (engine block stamping and ECU label).
Video of cold start and short run (showing no abnormal noise) and a simple diagnostic scan result if available.
Compression test (and/or leak-down) report with readings.
Photos showing completeness: list of included sensors/accessories and close-ups of connectors/mounting points.
Any import documents or proof of Belgium origin (bill of lading/receipt) if claiming Tokunbo.
response.reason: The photos show an engine assembly, but the exact engine identity and the seller’s “tested/working, no knock, low mileage, never opened” claims are not verifiable from these images. Without engine code and proof of test results, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
